chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

I heard him saying: Any woman who is divorced and then her husband dies before her waiting period (iddah) expires and she is not yet forbidden to him, then she inherits him. Then she observes the waiting period of the one who died for her (the deceased husband). If she dies while in her waiting period and she is not yet forbidden to him, then he inherits her.

key_terms.تَحْرُمْ عَلَيْهِ: She becomes forbidden to him (final divorce)

ai.seo_question: What are the inheritance rights of a divorced woman if her ex-husband dies before her waiting period ends?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfabar clarifies the legal status of a woman in the waiting period (iddah) of a revocable divorce (talaq raj'i) upon her husband's death, affirming her right to inherit as a full wife. It further establishes the reciprocal inheritance right if she passes away before the iddah concludes, highlighting the continuity of marital bonds until the finality of the divorce or the completion of the waiting period.
